records.issue_text: Notification failure swallowed in addGuests.handler.ts (~170-174): sendAddGuestsEmails errors are reduced to a console.log that drops the error object, the handler still returns success, and there is no retry, dead-letter record, or 'added but never notified' state marking

records.issue_text: Missing seat capacity enforcement in addGuests.handler.ts (~65-68): the handler reads booking.eventType?.seatsPerTimeSlot but never enforces it before createMany, creating plain Attendee rows on the parent booking that overbook past the seat limit and are disconnected from seat tracking (seatReferenceUid), violating a data invariant other code paths rely on
records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the mutation unconditionally appends new attendees via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` without any check against `booking.eventType?.seatsPerTimeSlot` (which is only copied into the `evt` object later).
